_comment: THE single source of truth for the vendored engine (unified-MCP spec §2.1). scripts/vendor-engine.mjs reads only this file; CI (ci.yml + publish-mcp.yml) checks out `repository` at `ref` and re-runs the script in --check mode, so the committed tree under `target` can never silently drift from the pinned commit. Bump `ref` + re-run `npm run vendor:engine` to take new engine code.
